headword: {良心|りょうしん}が{咎|とが}める
reading: りょうしんがとがめる
gloss: to feel guilty; to have a guilty conscience

definitions.gloss: to feel guilty; to have a bad conscience; to be troubled by one's conscience
definitions.explanation: An expression describing the internal discomfort felt when one knows one has done or is doing something morally wrong. Literally, 'one's conscience reproaches.' The subject is 良心 (conscience), not the person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{嘘|うそ}をついて→嘘をつく：21763_usowotsuku⟧{良心|りょうしん}が{咎|とが}めた。
{良心|りょうしん}が{咎|とが}めて、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: My guilty conscience led me to decide to tell the truth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{裏切|うらぎ}った→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{良心|りょうしん}が{咎|とが}めて、⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{苦|くる}しんだ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧。
examples.english: I was tormented for years by guilt over having betrayed my friend.

notes:
USAGE:
In this expression, ⟦{良心|りょうしん}→良心：13948_ryoushin⟧ (conscience) is the grammatical subject that does the ⟦{咎|とが}める→咎める：05346_togameru⟧ (reproaching). The person who feels guilty is not the subject but the one whose conscience is acting. The verb ⟦{咎|とが}める→咎める：05346_togameru⟧ on its own means to blame or find fault with. This is a relatively literary expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {良心|りょうしん}が{咎|とが}めて〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do something because of a guilty conscience)
- ⟦{良心|りょうしん}→良心：13948_ryoushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呵責|かしゃく} (pangs of conscience — related noun phrase)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後|うし}ろめたい→後ろめたい：12547_ushirometai⟧: feeling guilty, uneasy — an adjective for the same emotion
- ⟦{罪悪感|ざいあくかん}→罪悪感：05951_zaiakukan⟧: guilt, sense of sin — a more direct noun for the feeling of guilt
